notes: A verdict from the reader is no longer a verdict on the picture: the size you asked for is always played, so a phone that plays FULL HD is never talked down to 360p by a range request that happened to be refused.

A sharp size the player will not open is now read by the app itself, one megabyte at a time, into the media buffer - so 1080p, 2K and 4K no longer depend on the player accepting the address or on the phone holding the whole film in memory.
Only the part of the film in front of the picture is kept, so a 4K copy is never one huge allocation on a phone.
A size that shows no frame in its window is given up in one jump to the sharpest size that answered, and the size list marks the one that did not - never the one that is playing.
A size that is still fetching is no longer called dead at the first deadline: it gets one more window before the picture moves.
